```yaml
name: vfox.rs Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        rust-version: ['1.56', '1.60', 'nightly']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust-version }}
        target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu,x86_64-apple-darwin,x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        components: rustfmt,cargo-clippy

    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
      with:
        command: install
        args: --path .

    - name: Run tests
      uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
      with:
        command: test
        args: --all-features

    - name: Check for typos
      uses: crate-ci/typos@master
      with:
        files: '**/*.rs'
        extend_identifiers: true
        extend_words: true
        isolated: true
        write_changes: false

    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        files: ./target/debug/deps/vfox*
        directory: ./target/debug/
        fail_ci_if_error: true
```

name: vfox.rs Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        rust-version: ['1.56', '1.60', 'nightly']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust-version }}
        target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu,x86_64-apple-darwin,x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        components: rustfmt,cargo-clippy

    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
      with:
        command: install
        args: --path .

    - name: Run tests
      uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
      with:
        command: test
        args: --all-features

    - name: Check for typos
      uses: crate-ci/typos@master
      with:
        files: '**/*.rs'
        extend_identifiers: true
        extend_words: true
        isolated: true
        write_changes: false

    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov

        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        files: ./target/debug/deps/vfox*
